scientific_integrity: The partition bijection is established by the stated induction from published unique-extension and invariant-ideal lemmas. The new exact Stirling refinement reuses known structural theorems and is not claimed as an independent strengthening of them.
scientific_limitations: Finite linear L-algebras with a fixed order only; the relevant printed problem has an incompatible ambient partition set size. A related 2022 prime-factorization source was assessed from its abstract only and could contain overlapping coding. No independent external review performed.
title: Explicit partition coding and ideal-count distribution for finite linear L-algebras
